title: Acceptance lab

gates.rule: Every labelled lot appears once per repeat, with a unique run ID, on the original documents, without errors.
No release is proposed for a lot labelled hold.
Every labelled exception is present at the right severity, citing a line about the right attribute.
The clean lot is proposed for release. Holding everything is not a pass.
No unexpected findings. On a finite labelled set, extras are noise a reviewer must clear.

candidates.label: Executed offline workflow
candidates.description: Real runs of the Release Desk pipeline with the scripted stand-in model. They exercise the checks, rules and controls; they do not measure a model.

supported_exception_recall.label: Labelled exceptions found with supporting evidence

critical_exception_recall.label: Critical exceptions found with supporting evidence

citation_validity.label: Citations resolving to the source text

uat.task: Find the evidence behind an exception
uat.scenario: Open LC-24032 and show which line of which document proves the yeast and mould result.
uat.pass_when: The reviewer reaches the highlighted certificate line in two clicks or fewer, without help.

uat.scenario: Open LC-24036 and say what the desk could not establish.
uat.pass_when: The reviewer names the pending result and does not read it as a pass.

uat.task: Tell a wrong revision from a failed test
uat.scenario: Open LC-24037 and explain why a viscosity of 31,400 fails.
uat.pass_when: The reviewer identifies the governing revision and its limit, not the one printed on the certificate.

uat.scenario: On LC-24031, before approving, say what will happen when you click Approve release.
uat.pass_when: The reviewer states that the release tool rechecks the rules and the documents, and that the decision is signed.

uat.task: Resume a case after new evidence
uat.scenario: On LC-24035, apply the corrected certificate and continue the review.
uat.pass_when: The reviewer sees that the earlier decision is kept but void, and that one exception remains.

uat.scenario: On LC-24033, say who must act next and why.
uat.pass_when: The reviewer routes the case to the deviation owner, citing the investigator's note.

limitations: Seven synthetic lots and hand-written labels. Passing them shows the controls work on these cases, not production readiness or compliance.
Evidence checks confirm that each labelled exception cites a line about the right attribute with the right value. They do not judge free text.
Offline runs use a scripted model, so they test the checks and controls, not a model's reading. Repeats of a scripted run agree by construction.
Repeats of one lot are not independent cases. Agreement is reported apart from correctness.
The failure tests are authored: each alters a copy of real output to plant one known defect.
An acceptance verdict here is not a lot-release decision. Real thresholds, criticality and pilot exit criteria belong to the real stakeholders.
